summary:
All five Tester steps now pass (5/5). The store is static HTML with the catalogue in `js/products.js` and everything rendered client-side, so agents saw no products at all. Changes:

- **Build script (`scripts/build.mjs`, no dependencies)**: reads the catalogue from the store's own data file (`js/products.js`) and generates at build time:
  - `/products/<slug>/index.html` — one plain-HTML page per product (name in `<h1>`, price as text, description, image, availability) reusing the site's existing stylesheet, header and footer, plus Product JSON-LD (name, description, image, sku, url, offers with price/priceCurrency/availability).
  - `/buy/<slug>/index.html` — a no-JavaScript cart page ("Your cart", product, price, qty 1) with a "Checkout" link, linked from each product page's "Add to cart" link.
  - `/checkout/<slug>/index.html` — a shareable checkout page with the order summary in the HTML; `js/checkout.js` now loads the item from the page (or from `checkout.html?items=<slug>:<qty>,…`) into the cart in the browser, so the link opens the same order on any device without cookies.
  - `/sitemap.xml` (homepage, shop, all product pages) and `/llms.txt` (store summary, product list with prices, "How to buy").
- **Homepage & shop page**: a plain-HTML product list (name, price, image, link to the generated product pages) is injected between markers in the built HTML; the JS app still takes over for humans and the homepage keeps its original curated "Loved right now" grid.
- **Deploy hook**: added a minimal `package.json` with `"build": "node scripts/build.mjs"` so the pages regenerate on deploy (Vercel serves the real files).
- No prices, products, design or business rules changed; the JS shopping flow works exactly as before.
